interests.title: Learning Dynamics
interests.question: How can learning systems remain stable under feedback, strategic interaction, and environmental drift?
interests.questionZh: 学习系统如何在反馈、策略互动和环境漂移中保持稳定？
interests.description: Entropy-regularized RL, non-stationary learning, logit responses, and game dynamics.
interests.descriptionZh: 熵正则强化学习、非平稳学习、Logit 响应与博弈动力学。

interests.title: Adaptive Computation
interests.question: How should a model allocate computation according to the structure and difficulty of each input?
interests.questionZh: 模型如何依据输入的结构与难度动态分配计算量？
interests.description: Trainable computation paths, efficient inference, and internal routing in language models.
interests.descriptionZh: 可训练计算路径、高效推理与语言模型内部路由。

interests.title: Reliable Learning
interests.question: What observable structure tells us when a learning procedure is stable and trustworthy?
interests.questionZh: 哪些可观测结构能够判断学习过程是否稳定、可信？
interests.description: Spectral coverage, prompt-length selection, and stability under resampling.
interests.descriptionZh: 谱覆盖、Prompt 长度选择与重采样下的稳定性。
